name: portfolio-refresh
description: A static portfolio with 13 case studies, responsive layouts and a small progressive-enhancement layer. Content is readable without JavaScript. All existing project URLs and images remain available.

scripts.build: npm run build:motion && python3 tools/build.py && python3 tools/package.py
scripts.test: python3 tools/check.py && python3 tools/check-refinement.py && node --check assets/js/portfolio.js && node tools/check-analytics.cjs && node tools/check-video.cjs && python3 tools/check-atmosphere.py && node tools/check-ambient.cjs && node tools/check-section-motion.cjs
